reviews.review:
Don't waste your money. The game has been out for 4 years and there are still bugs and glitches with even the smallest of things in this game. Especially with collision detection. Avoid ARMA 3 if possible. It would be a good game if it wasn't so broken and badly optimized.
APEX did fix a lot of the optimisation issues. HOWEVER me and a friend of mine has noticed the previous couple of updates have sent optimisation out of the window and now has random lag spikes affecting audio too. Some lag spikes have crashed the game and a PC restart was the only way to fix. To confirm this I have played multiple, highly demanding, games such as Watchdogs 2, among others, which have caused no issues. I have also tested on multiple ARMA 3 servers, the issues happen on all of them so I can conclude that the issue is with the game itself.
Before anyone states; "upgrade your PC then", I would like to state that my PC has an AMD FX-9590 4.7Ghz Octacore processor, Nvidia GTX 960 4GB graphics card and 32GB of RAM. Pretty sure my computer is not the problem here ;)

After considerable time spent playing this game, it's really a thumbs-to-the-side for me.  I want to like it, I want to be good at it, but it has probably the worst UI I've ever experienced in a game.  Beyond that it's so laggy in big multiplayer maps that it's hard to play (and my rig is decent).  I've mostly been playing King of the Hill, which is either tons of fun (rarely) or the least amount of fun I've ever had playing a video game (often). Probably worth ~$30. Absolutely not worth $60.

After 650+ Hrs of gameplay I can thouroughly say that this is one of the best games I have ever played. The DLC for Helicopters is a little overpriced, there are some bugs that still persist occasionally but they are paled in compairison to the fantastic gameplay, realism, and fantastic community. When I say fantastic community I do mean it but be aware of the ♥♥♥♥♥ who like to hang out on the wasteland and RP servers. Other than that, it's an A++ game and I highly recommend it to all.
